Tax by market (the nine cells of the tax matrix on "Inputs", 0% by default; the formulas treat the price as tax-inclusive, so don't type a US sales tax there):
• US: menu prices are pre-tax and sales tax is added on the bill. Leave 0%.
• Canada: price before tax, as in the US. Leave 0%.
• UK: printed prices must include VAT. Type 20%; most cold takeaway food is zero-rated, but soft drinks are not.
• Australia: prices include GST. Type 10%.
15: Beverage cost is measured on NET sales (before tax) and on cost NET of any tax you get back: in the US, sales tax you pay on supplies is a cost; if you're registered for VAT or GST/HST, the tax on your purchases is cash flow, not cost.
